notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Praedyth’s Revenge is following in other sniper's footsteps. You can go with a tried and true perk combo of Fourth Time's the Charm and High-Impact Reserves like the IKELOS_SR_v1.0.2 did first, enhanced Kinetic Tremors for two shot AoE or Rewind Rounds for non stop firing line like Supremacy. Either way it feels like Bungie didn't push the needle as far with this refresh. Granted it's like the fourth time(‘s the charm) this sniper has been released so it's understandable." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Bumping your handling to 100 is easy with our newest Rapid-fire frame sniper. Fluted Barrel, a Handling MW and the Tactical mod bring you to over 100. Enhanced Kinetic Tremors can allow you to relive the glory days of rapid-fire snipers and two shot body again. Opening Shot will help make sure you don't have to body shot to kill." Recommended MW: Handling.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 131 from 5 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/2TAB3PL2u2Qigv2YejzhGJ?si=09c3555ccf5c4dcc) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for sustained damage against Bosses in both general at-level or better, and in end-game underleveled content. The combination of trait perks and the Timelost Magazine origin trait make Praedyth's Revenge a serious option for a boss special weapon when using a heavy that does damage over time. At base, the stats are excellent by comparison with its peers - 34 Range and 49 Zoom, 40 Stability is ×1.1225 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 70 Handling is 0.32s ready, 0.37s ADS and 0.29s stow speed, 63 Reload Speed is a 2.65s reload (2.12s with the Rapid-Fire frame intrinsic when reloading from an empty magazine) and Recoil Direction is 55. Base magazine size is 6 (maximum 7), and with 0/1/2/3 reserves mods total ammo is 30/32/35/35 (max 35). You'll need to keep hitting crits, so use the barrel perk to improve the Recoil Direction, or add Stability. For the magazine perk, Tactical Mag gets you to the maximum of 7 shots to make the most of the origin trait, or look to just increase Stability or Reload Speed with Flared Magwell or Alloy Mag. Kinetic Tremors in the first trait perk column gives you the option for double damage perks and AoE damage (after 3 hits, or 2 when enhanced), but remember it can only proc on a target once, so it only makes sense for one Guardian in a fireteam to be using it. The second column offers a traditional Bait and Switch for ×1.3 damage for rotating through your weapons or Elemantal Honing for up to ×1.4 damage if you can cycle through five different elemental damage types - both of these multipliers also affect Kinetic tremors damage too. The Timelost Magazine origin trait is very strong for PvE - essentially, the Thresh trait perk for free to build your super quickly on kills, and then providing a ×2 magazine size for 20s after your super finishes, refilling the mag from your reserves, making it ideal for boss damage phases. Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod in you aren't at 7 shots in the mag or Adept Stability or Counterbalance (depending on your barrel perk) if you are, or when fully enhanced possibly an Anti-Flinch or Tactical Mod. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Handling] "Praedyth's is the perfect burst DPS Sniper. With access to Rewind Rounds and High Impact Reserves (Frenzy can sometimes be better if you're taking damage), you can practically empty the entire gun in one sitting. On Console, invest in Stability for efficiency's sake, and on PC, aim for Handling. Range plays a part in Aim Assist at, well, range - for actual long-range encounters, you're likely better using something more precise." tags:god-pve
